# Polish level

**How produced is the reel?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C13, C21, C27


## Full polish
<a id="full-polish"></a>

SFX on every event, easing on every move, counters and badges, a change every 1.5–2.5 s.

**Looks like:** Every text pop has a sound, every zoom glides, numbers count up, cards spring in. It feels like a studio made it.

**Good at:** retention; premium feel; authority

**Weak at:** slow to make; polish can't fix a weak hook

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long · niches tech, all · goals retention, trust · effort high

**How:** HyperFrames graphics plus the real-sfx skill, easing curves in CapCut/VN keyframes, and an earshot check.

**Backed by:** [A sound on every visual event](../topics/sound.md#sound-sfx-every-event), [Nothing linear](../topics/effects.md#fx-nothing-linear), [Animated number counters](../topics/effects.md#fx-number-counter), [Something new on screen every 1.2–2.5 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-change-every-1-5-2-5s), [SFX meanings: whoosh, pop, chime, thud](../topics/sound.md#sound-sfx-meaning-map) · sources L01, L02, L03, R1

## Polish the key beats only
<a id="selective-polish"></a>

Craft goes into the hook, the punchline and the end; the middle stays simple.

**Looks like:** A designed hook with a music dropout after the punchline, plain captions through the middle, about 10 SFX across 41 visual events, and a styled CTA.

**Good at:** good look at moderate effort; emphasis means more; sustainable weekly

**Weak at:** the middle can sag; you need to choose the beats

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals retention, speed · effort medium

**How:** Mark three key beats in the storyboard and polish only those.

**Backed by:** [Half-second music dropout after the punchline](../topics/sound.md#l10-dropout-after-punchline), [SCORE and EMPHASIS lines per beat](../topics/sound.md#l10-storyboard-score-emphasis), [Sell a long video with a hyper-edited teaser](../topics/editing.md#edit-teaser-hyper-edited), [Subtle 105–110% punch-in on key phrases](../topics/effects.md#fx-subtle-punch-in), [Cut on the beat or on motion](../topics/editing.md#edit-cut-on-beat-motion) · sources L10, L08

## Just trimmed
<a id="just-trimmed"></a>

Cut the dead air, add captions, post. Quality is what the audience says it is.

**Looks like:** A phone on a tripod, one take, jump cuts, auto-captions. Some of the most viral videos are shot at night on a phone.

**Good at:** speed; volume; authentic; learning fast

**Weak at:** less retention on teaching content; less premium

**Best for:** formats reel30, story, yt-short · niches all · goals speed, trust · effort low

**How:** Edits: trim, auto-captions, export. Five minutes.

**Backed by:** [Quality is defined by the audience](../topics/filming.md#film-quality-audience-defined), [Accordion: volume to learn, then effort](../topics/growth.md#growth-accordion-method), [Perfect is the enemy of posted](../topics/growth.md#growth-perfect-enemy-of-posted), [Context in the first words, three channels](../topics/hooks.md#hook-context-first-words), [Pick one goal: comments, sends or saves](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-conversation-goal) · sources L05, L08

## Polish by platform
<a id="by-platform"></a>

Candid iPhone footage for TikTok-style feeds; produced edits where the platform rewards them.

**Looks like:** The same idea as a raw iPhone take on TikTok and a designed, SFX-rich cut on Instagram or YouTube.

**Good at:** fits each feed; reuses one idea; platform-native feel

**Weak at:** two edits to make; more files to manage

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short, yt-long · niches all · goals reach, speed · effort medium

**How:** Raw export first, then a polished version from the same timeline.

**Backed by:** [TikTok: more candid, shot on iPhone](../topics/filming.md#film-tiktok-candid-iphone), [Native beats identical cross-posting](../topics/growth.md#growth-native-over-cross-post), [iPhone 15: frame rates, modes, HDR](../topics/filming.md#film-iphone15-frame-rates), [Copy only true outliers](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-outliers-vs-own-average) · sources L07, L05

## Mixing
The accordion runs just-trimmed early and full polish later. Caleb's red flag is polish without a hook, not polish itself; his own course is highly produced.

## Rule of thumb
Learning and volume: just trimmed. Flagship teaching or tech reels: full polish. Most weeks: selective. Multi-platform: by platform.
